label: MEF2D::BCL9

sections.text: MEF2D encodes a MADS-box transcription factor involved in differentiation and cell survival.
BCL9 encodes a transcriptional cofactor for beta-catenin signaling.

The fusion preserves MEF2D DNA-binding and dimerization regions and changes transcriptional regulation, defining a MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL program. These leukemias often have weak CD10 expression and increased HDAC9-associated transcription.
MEF2D-rearranged B-ALL has shown relatively poor outcomes in several pediatric and young-adult cohorts.
